steps.action: remove rows where all 24 columns are missing
steps.reason: the same 65 rows have missing values across the entire block of current-transaction, historical, rolling-frequency, categorical, date and noise variables; ID, customer_id and repeat_purchase_90d remain present. Removing these incomplete purchase records avoids retaining observations with no usable predictor information while preserving all other rows.

steps.action: left join clientes.csv to the cleaned train dataset
steps.reason: clientes.csv contains customer-level attributes and can be linked to each purchase occasion through customer_id. A left join preserves every cleaned purchase row; because customer_id is unique in clientes.csv, the join does not duplicate purchase records.
